name: Pac-Man Party 3D
description:
In "Party Mode," where you go around the field on the board game and collect cookies, you can explore three worlds, including the plains and the ghost town, while competing in mini-game battles!

The game progresses through a series of mini-games that all game participants can enjoy at the same time. There is no stress of waiting time that is common with board games.

In more than 50 types of mini-game battles, you can use the collected power cookies to get a chance to turn the tables! The power cookie effects vary depending on the game, so have fun trying them out!
